description.value: The Ucluelet Aquarium holds the distinction of being Canada's first collect-and-release aquarium, returning all its marine animals to local waters at the end of each season. Situated on the traditional territory of the Yuułuʔiłʔatḥ – Ucluelet First Nation, it offers hands-on encounters with fish and invertebrates drawn from Clayoquot and Barkley Sounds. For cyclists exploring the west coast of Vancouver Island, it is a compelling cultural and natural-history stop in the heart of Ucluelet village.
